seoTitle: NCIS Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the NCIS test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Gibbs, Tony, Ziva, McGee, Abby, Ducky or Palmer — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the leader, the joker, or the heart of the team? Answer 11 everyday questions about work, friends and loyalty, and find out which NCIS character you are.

characters.name: Leroy Jethro Gibbs
characters.title: The Leader
characters.summary: Quiet, tough and loyal to your team. You don't say much, but when you do, people listen.
description: Like Gibbs, you lead by example. He's the head of NCIS's Major Case Response Team, and a former Marine sniper.
You live by your own code. Gibbs has a long list of personal rules, and he gives his team a "Gibbs-slap" when they mess up.
You work with your hands. Gibbs builds boats in his basement, and he names one after his daughter, Kelly.
characters.flaw: You keep everything locked up inside.
characters.signature: A hard stare, a short sentence and a boat in the basement.
characters.clashReason: they'd give you a look that said everything, and say nothing

characters.name: Tony DiNozzo
characters.title: The Joker
characters.summary: Funny, charming and always quoting a movie. You keep everyone laughing, and you're smarter than you let on.
description: Like Tony, you're the life of the party. He's the team's senior field agent, and a former homicide detective.
You've got a quote for everything. Tony makes endless movie references, and Ziva jokes that his last words will be "I've seen this film."
You're sharper than you look. Tony is a flirt who loves pranks, but he's much smarter than his playboy act suggests.
characters.flaw: You'd rather crack a joke than say how you really feel.
characters.signature: A movie quote, a cheeky grin and a prank in progress.
characters.clashReason: they'd tease you about it for the rest of the week

characters.name: Ziva David
characters.title: The Fearless One
characters.summary: Fearless, direct and incredibly skilled. You say exactly what you mean, even if the saying comes out a little wrong.
description: Like Ziva, you're fearless. She starts as a Mossad officer working with NCIS, and later joins the team.
You do things your own way. Ziva drives fast, is skilled with knives and often mixes up English sayings.
You'll do anything to protect your family. Ziva fakes her own death to keep her family safe, before reuniting with Tony and their daughter, Tali, in Paris.
characters.flaw: You'd rather handle it yourself than admit you need help.
characters.signature: A fast car, a sharp mind and a saying that's almost right.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what they think, with zero sugarcoating

characters.name: Timothy McGee
characters.title: The Brain
characters.summary: Smart, earnest and quietly talented. You're the one everyone underestimates, until they need you.
description: Like McGee, you're the smart one. He studied biomedical engineering at Johns Hopkins and computer forensics at MIT.
You've got a secret talent. McGee writes best-selling mystery novels under the pen name Thom E. Gemcity, an anagram of his name.
You stick around. McGee starts as the team's "probie," and he becomes the longest-serving character on the show.
characters.flaw: You take the teasing to heart more than you let on.
characters.signature: A laptop, a half-written novel and a nickname you didn't choose.
characters.clashReason: they'd explain the tech to you in far too much detail

characters.name: Abby Sciuto
characters.title: The Heart
characters.summary: Bubbly, brilliant and full of surprises. You bring the energy, the hugs and the answers.
description: Like Abby, you're one of a kind. She's the team's forensic scientist, known for her gothic style.
You run on energy. Abby is addicted to a super-caffeinated drink called Caf-Pow!
You're full of surprises. Abby is a devout Catholic who bowls on a team with nuns, and she's fluent in sign language.
characters.flaw: You feel everything at full volume.
characters.signature: A giant drink, a bubbly laugh and a hug for everyone.
characters.clashReason: they'd hug you when you just wanted a straight answer

characters.name: Ducky Mallard
characters.title: The Storyteller
characters.summary: Kind, cultured and never short of a story. You've seen a lot of life, and you love to share it.
description: Like Ducky, you love a good story. He's NCIS's Scottish-born chief medical examiner.
You never get to the point quickly. Ducky talks to the dead, and rambles to the living with long stories from history and his own life.
You've lived a full life. Ducky went to Eton and the University of Edinburgh, and served in the Royal Army Medical Corps.
characters.flaw: You take the long way round to every point.
characters.signature: A pot of tea, a kind word and a story that starts decades ago.
characters.clashReason: they'd answer your yes-or-no question with a twenty-minute story

characters.name: Jimmy Palmer
characters.title: The Sweetheart
characters.summary: Sweet, awkward and stronger than anyone expected. You grow into the job, and you never stop caring.
description: Like Palmer, you're sweet and a little awkward. He starts as Ducky's assistant, and Ducky calls him "Mr. Palmer."
You grow into the role. With Ducky's encouragement, Palmer becomes more confident, and he eventually becomes chief medical examiner.
You keep going. After losing his wife, Breena, Palmer raises their daughter, Victoria, on his own.
characters.flaw: You apologize for things that aren't your fault.
characters.signature: A nervous laugh, a kind word and a photo of your daughter on your desk.
characters.clashReason: they'd apologize so many times that you'd end up comforting them

questions.text: Your Saturday and Sunday are completely free. You...

options.text: Work on a woodworking project in your basement, alone
Have a movie marathon, quoting every line
Finally start writing that novel you've always talked about
Go bowling, and drink far too much caffeine

questions.text: Someone asks you a question you don't want to answer. You...

options.text: Stare at them in silence until they give up
Answer with a movie quote, and change the subject
Tell them, very directly, that it's none of their business
Smile, and politely pretend you didn't hear

questions.text: Someone new at work makes a mistake. You...

options.text: Give them a quick, sharp lesson they won't forget
Tease them about it for the rest of the week
Help them fix it, and tell them everyone makes mistakes
Explain the fascinating history of that exact mistake
Drive very, very fast
Text ahead, with an exact arrival time from your GPS
Stroll in with a great excuse and a grin
Apologize to everyone, very sincerely, several times

questions.text: A friend is going through a hard time. You...

options.text: Show up, say very little and just be there
Give them the biggest hug of their life
Make them a cup of tea, and tell them a story that puts it in perspective
Check in every day, and make sure they're eating

questions.text: Someone teases you in front of everyone. You...

options.text: Take it, then get them back later with a clever comeback
Say something blunt that ends it instantly
Laugh along, a little nervously
Laugh it off. You've heard far worse

questions.text: You have to learn a new skill, fast. You...

options.text: Look it up, master it overnight and write a guide
Learn it the hard way, with your own two hands
Throw yourself in, fearlessly
Get really excited, and color-code everything

questions.text: You're invited to a big birthday party. You...

options.text: Flirt with half the room
Charm the oldest guests with your excellent manners
Dance like nobody's watching
Help the host, and end up making new friends

questions.text: Someone hurts a person you love. You...

options.text: Track them down, using everything on your laptop
Make sure they regret it
Analyze every scrap of evidence until you find them
Stay cool, then go after them with everything you've got

questions.text: You're a medical examiner, and the body on your table has a strange story. You...

options.text: Talk to the body, as if it can hear you
Spot the one detail everyone missed, then trip over a cart
Run every test there is, twice
Ask for the short version

questions.text: You join a team of federal agents. You...

options.text: Become the joker who keeps everyone going
Prove yourself as the team's tech genius
Learn everyone's weaknesses, just in case
Make the lab your home, and the team your family
